Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1483
Claimant:
Susan Ramirez
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
1 Sep 2023
Claim reported by phone this morning after a low-speed head-on collision at a residential intersection. Insured driver
is listed on the policy and reports that the claimant was the front-seat passenger in the other vehicle, which is
consistent with the police report.
7 Sep 2023
Police attended the scene and recorded the claimant as present in the vehicle. Two independent witnesses gave
statements that match the insured's account of how the impact occurred.
14 Sep 2023
Photos from the scene show frontal damage to both vehicles that is consistent with the reported speed and angle of
impact. The other driver's statement describes the collision the same way.
4 Oct 2023
Claimant reported a head injury with headache and dizziness and was taken to hospital by ambulance. Diagnosis on
attendance was concussion, which fits the nature of the impact.
16 Dec 2023
Claimant's account at the hospital and in our first recorded call matches the scene evidence. Medical records show
no prior treatment to the head or neck in the recodrs available to us.
19 Dec 2023
Claimant is now represented by counsel, who has asked that all contact go through tehir office. Received a letter
requesting the full medical file and confirmed our handling of the claim.
10 Jan 2024
Inspection of the claimant's vehicle found a dent in the panel at the point of impact. A dated photo from an earlier
inspection shows the same dent, which conflicts with the reported timing of the damage and needs to be reviewed.
23 Jan 2024
Checked the policy start date and the coverage history. Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before
coverage began, and the insured driver is named on the policy as a listed driver.
8 Apr 2024
Treatment has continued for longer than is typical for a concussion of this kind, with follow-up appointments still being
booked. Counsel has provided updated treatment notes, which we are reviewing against the earlier records.
9 Apr 2024
Claimant's account has stayed the same in every conversation so far. The file remains open pending the review of the
earlier dented-panel photo and the ongoing medical records.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
